papers.title: Notice to visitors
lines: The Barbary macaques will take your sandwich, your sunglasses and your sense of dignity.
Do not feed them. Do not look them in the eye. Do not leave your bag.

papers.title: Border crossing diary
lines: Dear sister, they closed the border in 1969 and it is still shut. I have not seen you across the line in years.
We wave across the fence. We shout the football results. It is not much, but it is a start.

papers.title: Tunnel-digger's note
lines: Fifty kilometres of tunnels inside the Rock, dug by soldiers with drills and a tremendous tolerance for dust.
Some of them are still not on the map. Some of them are still not on the plan.

papers.title: Great Siege letter
lines: Dear wife, the siege continues. We are eating what we can find and dreaming of tea.
If I live I shall bring you a Gibraltar rock, a good deal heavier than a jewel.
